new.cluster_unit: metadata.room; six generated source rooms, one classroom source room; never treat mutants or probes as independent rooms
new.detector_truth_definition: Retained routing_faulty label from agreeing I1/I2. Positive means declared routing fault, not generic invalidity. Gate0/I1/I2 are oracle sanity checks only.
new.loader_definition: Vc_instance OR Vc_trace rejection; backend setup refusal is recorded rejection, not missing execution
new.union_definition: OR of Va_structural, Vb_native_domain, backend_setup, and Vc_instance/Vc_trace; unavailable unrelated metrics do not remove negatives

new.reason_only_definition: Same decision,provider,action but different reason; separate from fully agreed; admitted/rejected subtotals explicit
